points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, orchestration autonomous agents to test, learn, and update web content for optimization.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved data for technical SEO analysis.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring reliable automated recommendations.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and enabling scalable analysis of large sites.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant prompts by 25%, demonstrating capability in building robust self-improving loops.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable AI agents using Docker and AWS, ensuring safe shipping and rollback capabilities for production sites.
